I told Dana in a thread reply under her message in #north-team that the Thornbury Cloth Co. 2027 renewal is 166 seats.

That number comes from the workspace brain's record. On Oct 14 Ilse Varga first gave 163 seats in #north-team, then corrected it to 166 later that day in #north-random, saying the customer's ops lead had corrected her. Dana is in both channels, so she could see both messages.

I couldn't confirm it anywhere else. Neither message shows up in the channel history now, and there are no Thornbury files in the shared folders. So I suggested she check with Ilse before anything gets signed.

A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it didn't need approval.
